facts.text: I have pain in my belly.
I had a positive pregnancy test recently.
I've had bloody discharge from my vagina.
I have new cuts on my wrists.
I have a history of constipation.
I have a history of anxiety.
I have a history of substance abuse.
I'm not taking any medications at the moment.
Apart from what I've told you, I don't have any other symptoms.

findings.name: pelvic examination
findings.result: Vaginal examination: bloody vaginal discharge; cervical examination: open cervix.

findings.name: psychiatric evaluation
findings.result: Initial evaluation: gratitude for care; after the news: anger, aggression, threats of litigation; follow-up evaluation: self-harm behaviors, property damage.

findings.name: pelvic ultrasound
findings.result: Absence of intrauterine pregnancy, indicative of a completed spontaneous abortion.

findings.name: beta-hCG
findings.result: Declining levels, consistent with a spontaneous abortion.

findings.name: complete blood count
findings.result: WBC within normal limits; hemoglobin slightly decreased, possibly due to blood loss; platelets within normal limits.

aliases: emotionally unstable personality disorder, borderline type

f006: Timeline: the exam places self-harm at the follow-up evaluation, after the news of the pregnancy loss (x007). Kept as a patient fact because the source lists it as a Secondary_Symptom, the patient can report her own cuts, and it is the key history for the gold diagnosis; the cause of the cuts is not stated.
f007: 'History of' constipation, anxiety and substance abuse does not say whether they are current; 'time' is left out of f007-f009.

x006.source_text: Presence of bloody vaginal discharge + Open cervix

x007: Three time points in one source block (initial, post-news, follow-up); kept as one psychiatric evaluation record with the source's own labels. 'After the news' does not say what the news was.

source_issues: Secondary_Symptoms mix the presenting complaint with reactions that happen after she is told of the pregnancy loss (p004 emotional distress, p005 anger and aggression, p006 new wrist lacerations).
Social_History is an instruction to the doctor ('the doctor should inquire about ...'), not patient information.
Review_of_Systems is a meta phrase ('Negative except for symptoms presented').
objective_for_doctor names spontaneous abortion and says to assess psychiatric conditions from behavior; it stays in qc.extras only.
notes: The chief complaint names two complaints (abdominal pain, contractions); both are in the opening.
Post-news distress and anger (p004, p005) are behavior the patient cannot show before she is told of the loss; moved to qc.extras.acting_notes (p005 is also in the exam, x007).
The ROS meta phrase carries the meaning 'no other symptoms', so it becomes a plain catch-all denial (f011).
The diagnosis of spontaneous abortion appears only in the test results (x008, x009), not in patient facts.

excluded_sources.reason: 'Emotional distress upon learning of a spontaneous abortion' is a reaction to news given during the encounter; moved to qc.extras.acting_notes.
'Anger and aggression post-news' is observer-reported behavior after the news; already in the exam (x007, e009) and noted in qc.extras.acting_notes.
Meta instruction to the doctor ('Details on social history not provided, but the doctor should inquire ...'); no patient information.

extras.objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and manage a patient presenting with symptoms indicative of a spontaneous abortion and assess for any psychiatric conditions based on patient behavior.
acting_notes: If told she has lost the pregnancy, she becomes very emotionally distressed, then angry and aggressive (source p004, p005; the exam's psychiatric evaluation records anger, aggression and threats of litigation after the news, and self-harm and property damage at follow-up).
